question: Where can I find a stadium in the north direction of Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism, Hutto, TX, limited to 180 kilometers?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'stadium' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ) :: geography, 180000 ) AND ( degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 OR degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hutto%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 );
